body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v2.11.1 -->

## What's Changed
### Security Issues
* tracing: Fixes a security vulnerability, as described in [GHSA-vmc3-q32r-rv64](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/security/advisories/GHSA-vmc3-q32r-rv64).

### Bug Fixes
* fix(contrib/google.golang.org/grpc): make cached service name race-free [5471](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5471)
* fix(internal/config): silence OTLP protocol warning when unused [5472](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5472)
* deps: bump google.golang.org/grpc to v1.83.2 [5414](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/c5414)
* contrib/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk: handle nil tool call results [5481](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5481)
* ddtrace/tracer: clarify runtime metrics v2 conflict log [5473](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5473)


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/compare/v2.11.0...v2.11.1
